info.title: aex data plane
info.description: The workspace-scoped HTTP API. Authenticated with a workspace API key. Generated from packages/contracts/src/schemas/** and src/api-routes.ts — do not edit by hand.

workspaceApiKey.description: Workspace API key, sent as `Authorization: Bearer <key>`.

InlineSecrets.description: The vaulted half of a submission. Excluded from the idempotency hash and never echoed back.

SecretsEnvSecrets.description: Per-session env-var secret values. Keys must be valid env var names; each pairs with a `submission.secretEnv` declaration.

SecretsMcpServers.description: Per-session MCP server credentials. Server names must be unique.

SessionLimits.description: Per-session lineage-limit override. Shape and positivity only; clamping to the workspace and platform ceilings happens server-side in resolveSessionLimits.

SessionMachine.description: Capacity intent. An object with no `spot` carries no signal and is dropped; `spot: false` is preserved as an explicit request for standard capacity.

SessionWebhook.description: Run-callback registration. `url` must be https with no userinfo — enforced in packages/contracts/src/schemas/session-webhook.ts, and not expressible in JSON Schema.

SubmissionMcpServers.description: Remote MCP servers, each `{ name, url, transport? }`. Names must be unique and every URL must clear the SSRF host deny-list — enforced in packages/contracts/src/session-config.ts.

SubmissionNetworking.description: Egress policy. `mode` is required whenever `networking` is supplied — enforced in packages/contracts/src/schemas/submission-environment.ts.

SubmissionPackage.description: Package request. `name` may carry an ecosystem prefix ("pip:pandas"); an unprefixed name defaults to apt and an unknown prefix is rejected.

SubmissionPrompt.description: The run brief: one string, or an ordered list of non-empty parts. At least one part must carry non-whitespace text. A single string is normalised to a one-element list.

SubmissionSecretEnv.description: Env-var secret bindings keyed by env name. Each value is exactly one of `{ ref }` (a workspace secret handle matching ^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]{0,127}$) or `{ ephemeral: true }` (the value rides in `secrets.envSecrets`). Enforced in packages/contracts/src/schemas/submission-body.ts.
